# FinalYearKit

> Submission-ready final year project kits for B.Tech, BCA, BBA, and MCA students in India.
> Working code + 8-chapter report + presentation deck. Optional paid add-ons for customize, viva, install help, and walkthrough.

Website: https://finalyearkit.com
Contact: contact@finalyearkit.com
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917420879220

## What we sell

Final-year project packages (not generic GitHub dumps). Base package (₹999) includes:

- Full working source code with setup instructions
- 8-chapter academic Word report (placeholder name/college)
- ~14-slide presentation deck (placeholder name/college)

Optional paid add-ons: customize name/college (₹499), viva Q&A bank (₹499), installation help (₹499), walkthrough/explanation (₹749).

Delivery: Instant download (ZIP after payment) on ready projects; made-to-order projects take 50% now and deliver in a few hours via WhatsApp.

Payment: Razorpay on the website. Ask questions on WhatsApp before buying if needed.

## Blog (guides for students)

Architecture, viva prep, and project-picking posts live at https://finalyearkit.com/blog — including RAG explainers, viva question banks, AI vs MERN choice guides, and kit-specific defense notes.

## Audience & tone

Speak to Indian final-year students who need a defensible submission package. Prefer plain English. Kits are learning/reference resources — students remain responsible for their institution's academic integrity policy.
